scope.rule: Banks: the 10 banks in the savings.com.au top-10 by total residents assets plus the top-10 customer-owned banks by assets (both APRA data), legal names checked against the APRA register; plus the bank sub-brands St.George, Bank of Melbourne, BankSA, Bankwest and Virgin Money because CreditCardCompare lists them as separate card issuers. Card issuers: non-bank issuers on CreditCardCompare that are major stand-alone brands (American Express, Coles, Latitude Financial Services). BNPL: all six providers in ASIC 20-280MR (Openpay excluded as defunct). SACC: the three named in the Senate report plus every other lender on the Cash Converters comparison page. Wage advance: every provider named in the savings.com.au wage-advance article (CommBank AdvancePay folded into CBA). Personal/car loans: non-bank lenders in the Finder non-bank table and Lenders section (excluding banks, Revolut, broker Driva, EBP Money, Alex, Fox Symes) plus SocietyOne and Firstmac/loans.com.au from savings.com.au. Families are assigned only where a lender page or listing was cited.

bpay_biller_codes.product: Amex card accounts (reference = 15-digit Card Account number)
Card accounts per some Amex AU pages, incl. David Jones cards cancelled before 13 Jul 2024

lenders.notes: ABN 92 108 952 085, ACL 291313. Amex AU pages would not load directly (header overflow). The legal name, the AMEX usage and the biller codes come from the search index of Amex's own pages and PDFs, and from ASIC 22-352MR, which writes 'American Express Australia Limited (Amex)'. Amex pages conflict on the biller code (5082 vs 88013). Amex also issues co-brand cards (Qantas American Express, David Jones). ASIC instrument 24-0492 covers a card facility transfer between Latitude Finance Australia and American Express Australia Limited (https://download.asic.gov.au/media/w3xmzc3n/asic-instrument-24-0492-latitude-finance-australia-and-american-express-australia-limited.pdf).

Cards are issued by National Australia Bank Limited (ABN 12 004 044 937, ACL 230686) and distributed by Coles Supermarkets Australia Pty Ltd (ABN 45 004 189 708), per the Coles FAQ. Neither name is listed as an alias: NAB's legal name stays with the NAB lender, and the Coles Supermarkets entity name would match grocery spend. A 2020 key facts sheet names an earlier issuer, Citigroup Pty Limited. The brand alias 'COLES' is also the supermarket brand, so it is ambiguous for transaction matching. Biller code 8862 comes from the search-indexed text of the old financialservices.coles.com.au FAQ; the current FAQ page shows no BPAY code. Coles Personal Loans also exist (coles-personal-loans-tnc.pdf), but the Sept 2025 paydown notice could not be read, so neither the loan family nor its biller code was recorded.
ACN 169 342 947 (ABN 15 169 342 947), ACL 527911, per Afterpay's terms and loyalty terms. Owned by Block (Square). No BPAY biller code is published.

ABN 58 164 440 993, ACL 441878. Zip Money is a line of credit. Zip lets customers pay bills by BPAY from their Zip account, which is the reverse direction; Zip publishes no biller code for repaying Zip. The issuer list also shows 'Zip+', which was not recorded as an alias.
ABN 74 609 165 906, ACL 508217. Brighte now markets a 0% Interest Payment Plan plus Green and Personal Loans. Its homepage no longer uses the name 'BrightePay'.

aliases.text: CASH CONVERTERS PERSONAL FINANCE PTY LTD

lenders.notes: ACL 391436, per Cash Converters' comparison page; the entity holding it was not confirmed. The ABR returns many franchisee entities and trading names containing 'CASH CONVERTERS', and the brand is also used by the pawnbroking and second-hand retail stores, so it is ambiguous for transaction matching. The sacc family relies on a Senate Economics committee report naming Cash Converters, Money3 and Nimble as dominant SACC lenders; that page returned 403, so it was seen in search results only. The current flagship Cashies Loan is continuing credit ($2,050 to $10,000), not a SACC. CASHIES LOAN is a product name, kept because it identifies the provider.

ABN 36 108 979 406, ACL 389067. Money3 currently offers car and vehicle loans up to $75k and personal loans from $2,000, repaid by direct debit. The sacc family is historical: it rests only on the Senate report seen in search results, so treat it as weak.

ABN 91 135 501 807, ACL 386010 (ASIC 16-089MR). Cash Doctors Australia Pty Ltd is a former name of the same ABN, and ASIC calls Nimble 'previously Cash Doctors'. Nimble offers Small Loans of $500 to $2,000 (SACC) and Personal Loans of $2,050 to $5,000. A trade-press report (adviservoice.com.au, not checked against a primary source) says SkyCredit, the parent of Fair Go Finance, acquired Nimble in 2024.

ACN 130 894 405, ACL 422839. The site says Credit24 is a registered trademark and business name of IPF Digital Australia Pty Ltd. It offers Small Loans of $2,000 or under (20% establishment fee plus a monthly fee, which are SACC terms) alongside line of credit, medium and personal loans.

ABN 53 162 078 195, ACL 456404. It is also on savings.com.au's personal loan lender list, so another fork may have recorded it too.

ABN 18 134 369 574, ACL 387995. The reported parent is SkyCredit Pty Ltd, which is also reported to own Nimble. ASIC 16-027MR (2016) calls it a payday lender. The homepage returned 502, so details came from the ABR and from search-indexed fairgofinance.com.au pages.
